name: spaghetti and meatballs
instructions:
Real meatballs in a crushed-tomato sauce over spaghetti. The meatballs are a classic panade build; the sauce base is CRUSHED TOMATOES or CRUSHED FIRE-ROASTED TOMATOES, sharpened with RED WINE VINEGAR and OREGANO. NO ONIONS ANYWHERE in this dish.

=== THE MEATBALLS (WHAT GOES INSIDE) ===

- ground beef
- MILK-SOAKED (stale) BREAD — the panade
- black pepper
- fresh parsley, chopped
- PARMESAN CHEESE, grated
- GRATED GARLIC
- salt

Mix, shape into meatballs, and brown in olive oil.

=== THE SAUCE ===

- white wine (for the deglaze)
- crushed tomatoes OR crushed fire-roasted tomatoes
- red wine vinegar
- oregano

DEGLAZE the browned meatballs with WHITE WINE before adding the crushed tomatoes. Then the vinegar and oregano; simmer until thickened.

=== SERVE ===

Toss with spaghetti.
notes:
=== RENAMED (SEPTEMBER 2026) ===

Formerly 'fire roasted meatballs' — renamed now that fire-roasted is the optional smoky direction rather than the identity, and the dish is the classic. (Before that it was an impossible-meat build; git history has both.)

=== THE MEATBALL INTERIOR — THE FULL STACK ===

Inside the meatballs: milk-soaked bread, pepper, parsley, parmesan cheese, and grated garlic (plus the beef and salt). The bread-in-milk panade keeps them tender; the parmesan and garlic season from within; parsley is the herb inside the meatball, oregano the herb on the sauce side.

=== NO ONIONS — ANYWHERE ===

Onions shouldn't appear anywhere in this dish — not in the meatballs, not in the sauce. Clashing.

=== SAUCE — CRUSHED TOMATOES, FIRE-ROASTED OPTIONAL ===

Crushed tomatoes are the base; crushed FIRE-ROASTED tomatoes are the equally valid smoky direction. Red wine vinegar and oregano are both primary — the vinegar sharpens the sauce. Tomato paste stays out.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[bolognese]]: the other ragu — ground meat loose in the sauce rather than shaped. The meatball-per-forkful format is what this recipe is for.
- [[weeknight-vegetarian-ragu]]: the no-ceremony weeknight end of the family.
- [[marcella-gnocchi-sauce]]: the protein-free tomato-sauce side.
